beats.summary: Pam recalls Jim's humorous Valentine's Day card from last year featuring Dwight's head.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I really like Valentine's Day in this office. It's kinda like grade school. Everybody gives out little presents and stuff.
Like last year, Jim gave me this card, with Dwight's head on it, it was horrifying and funny and…

beats.summary: Phyllis receives multiple Valentine's Day gifts from Bob Vance, including flowers and an oversized bear.

evidence.snippet:
Delivery Man: Phyllis Lapin.
Pam: OH, Holy God!
Delivery Man: It's from Bob.

beats.summary: Michael is going to New York for a business presentation and is avoiding discussing his past with Jan on Valentine's Day.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Alright Dwight, as you know I am heading to New York today. Doing a presentation on the branch to the new CFO.
Michael: This is a business trip. I would have to be a raving lunatic to try to talk to Jan about what happened between us.

beats.summary: Jim is single after breaking up with Katy and plans a low-key Valentine's Day with friends.

evidence.snippet: Jim: So I broke up with Katy and haven't been dating anybody else, so this year I don't have to worry about Valentine's Day.
I invited a couple of friends over. We're gonna play some cards and I'll end up winning a lotta money.

beats.summary: Kelly excitedly shares with Jim that she finally hooked up with Ryan.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: So I said, "Ryan, what took you so long?" And I just said that to him, can you believe that?

beats.summary: Michael explores New York City landmarks and experiences typical city life during his trip.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Here it is, heart of New York City, Times Square.
Michael: Everybody takes the subway in New York. It's fast, it's efficient, gets you there on time.
